skills.name: Same-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly when the two fractions (or fraction parts) share the same denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert unlike-denominator fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of two mixed numbers or a whole number and a mixed number.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative result, borrow 1 from the whole number (as denominator/denominator) and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is greater than or equal to the denominator into standard proper mixed-number form before subtracting.

skills.name: Numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fractional parts) that already share a common denominator, including trivial or negative intermediate results.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number or whole number into its whole-number and fractional components so the whole parts and fractional parts can be subtracted independently.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one unit from the whole part (expressed as denominator/denominator) and add it to the fraction before re-subtracting.

skills.name: Improper fractional-part normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose written fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before performing the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fractional parts) that already share a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number portions of two mixed numbers (or a mixed number and a whole number) independently of the fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrow for negative fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative result, borrow one whole unit from the whole-number part (as denominator/denominator) and add it to the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed-number fraction
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part before subtracting.

skills.name: Represent whole number as zero-fraction mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with the target denominator and a zero-numerator fraction part so it can be subtracted using the mixed-number procedure.

skills.name: Common-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators (or fraction parts) directly once both fractions share the same denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two unlike-denominator fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-number part decomposition/subtraction
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number (or whole number, treated as whole+0/d) into whole and fractional components and subtract the whole-number parts independently of the fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping for negative fraction difference
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction would be negative, borrow 1 from the whole-number part (expressed as d/d) and add it to the minuend's fraction numerator before subtracting.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part's numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator (e.g., 2 3/2) into standard mixed-number form by extracting extra whole units before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction that has a common factor greater than 1 between numerator and denominator to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions' numerators once they share a common denominator, keeping that denominator, whether for pure fractions or the fractional parts of mixed numbers.

skills.name: LCD determination and conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result (including a zero numerator reducing to 0) to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their common factor.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the integer (whole-number) parts of two mixed numbers, treating any operand lacking an explicit whole part as having whole 0.

skills.name: Borrow one whole unit
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction produces a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole-part difference and add it to the minuend's fraction before subtracting again.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by moving whole units out of the fraction into the whole-number part, before subtracting.

skills.name: Represent whole number as zero-fraction mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a standalone whole-number operand as 'whole + 0/d' using the needed denominator so it aligns with the other mixed number/fraction for subtraction.
